# Reflection
## Inactivity Gap
21-09-20 to 22-08-09
## Discussion
This project had a decently long 9-month break after its initial V0.2.0 release. It appears that this was a simple break after its first released version, as commits were pretty consistent before then. This project looks like a simple development cycle in which commits were prevelant untill its first release in which they did simple fixes and additions to get them to future releases. This makes sense as the commits both before and after the break related to bug fixes and document updates.
